question: Who won the 2025 Tour de France, and by what margin?
text: Tadej Pogačar won the 2025 Tour de France, finishing **4 minutes and 24 seconds** ahead of runner-up Jonas Vingegaard in the overall standings. It was Pogačar’s fourth Tour title. ([letour.fr](https://www.letour.fr/en/news/2025/fourmidable-pogacar/1332891?utm_source=openai))
